data.title: Grand Mosque Imam Highlights Importance of Moderation, Balance in Friday Sermon
data.content:
Makkah, November 20, 2026, SPA -- In his Friday sermon at the Grand Mosque, Imam Sheikh Yasser Al-Dossary advised Muslims to maintain mindfulness of Allah, explaining that moderation and balance form a comprehensive religious framework that governs life through proper prioritization and avoids both extremism and negligence in accordance with Prophetic guidance.
    He noted that moderation entails balancing spiritual and physical needs, worldly affairs and the afterlife, and steadfastness in core principles alongside contemporary awareness guided by established scholars and credible official sources.
    Sheikh Al-Dossary concluded by affirming that moderation is a cornerstone of national stability and social cohesion, while highlighting Saudi Arabia's ongoing support for Muslim causes and sacred sites, foremost among them the blessed Al-Aqsa Mosque.
    -- SPA
